description: Look up Dart and Flutter packages on pub.dev from a workflow. Search packages by keyword, SDK, platform, topic, licence or publisher and rank them by downloads, likes, pub points or how recently they changed; read a package's latest release, the versions it has published, one version's dependencies and archive, its score and pub points report, its security advisories and its API docs; look up a verified publisher, check whether a name is free for a new package, and list topics. Triggers start a workflow when a package publishes a new version or a new package matching a search appears. Every action reads public data and changes nothing. No account or API key required.
